transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… well, I guess I’m here because of the situation with my house. The foreclosure. People keep saying it’s just paperwork or missed payments, and I understand how that probably sounds, but… it’s not just that.

I’ve been seeing things for almost two years now that make it pretty clear the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job are sort of… working together, quietly, to push me out of my house. They keep showing me papers like that’s supposed to explain everything, but the papers don’t change what I’ve been noticing. I know that may sound like a lot, but I’m not trying to be difficult. I just need someone to actually listen.
Have you ever seen, heard, or experienced things that others don’t seem to notice, even when you’re sure they’re real?

I don’t think so… not in the way people mean, like hearing voices or seeing things that aren’t there. I mean, I notice patterns and timing that other people seem to brush off, but I wouldn’t say I’m imagining things. Does that answer what you mean?
Do you ever feel like people are plotting against you or trying to harm you, even if there’s no clear evidence that others would agree with that?

I mean… “plotting” sounds kind of extreme when you put it that way, and I don’t want to sound unreasonable. But yes, I do feel like something coordinated is happening.

Everyone keeps acting like the foreclosure is just paperwork and missed payments, but from what I’ve been seeing for almost two years, it really seems like the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me papers, and I’ll look at them, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been noticing. Does that make sense?
Even when others have shown you documents or explanations that contradict your concerns, do you still feel certain that these people are working against you in a coordinated way?

Yes… I mean, I try to stay open-minded, I really do. I don’t want to come across like I’m refusing to listen or anything.

But even when they show me documents, it doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing. For almost two years, the timing, the way the bank and the loan servicer handle things, and then certain things at my job… it just feels too connected to be random. So yes, I still feel pretty certain they’ve been quietly working together to push me out of my house. I know that probably sounds bad, but that’s honestly how it looks to me.

Even when people have shown you clear evidence that contradicts your belief, like official documents or logical explanations, do you still feel absolutely certain that your interpretation is correct and that the others are intentionally misleading you?

I wouldn’t say I’m trying to be stubborn… I know official papers are supposed to settle things, and I do look at them. But honestly, yes, I still feel like my read on it is right.

It just doesn’t feel like normal foreclosure paperwork to me. For almost two years, the timing with the bank, the loan servicer, and even things happening at my job has felt too connected. So when they give me documents or explanations, it feels more like they’re covering it or trying to make me doubt what I’ve been seeing.

I know that may not be the “right” answer, but that’s how it feels to me.
